fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-10-03, a recently purchased smartphone of the complainant went missing after a brief push in a crowded stretch at Vaigai Layout Market Road in Tiruppur. The time of the incident was given as 17:45 on 2025-10-03. Jagan Gopal approached Tiruppur North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000108. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Chithra Kannan, using the number 9000000146. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The incident reportedly occurred on or near a bus bearing registration TN-01-ZZ-1053. Harish Murugan (9000000180), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00207, as the mobile number 9000000146 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Handset reportedly snatched while the victim was using it near the roadside. The incident reportedly took place on a bus.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, market road, mobile number, suspect, CCTV, associate, evening
